name: Jean-Luc Dubois
bio:
Jean-Luc's fascination with motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to the Spa-Francorchamps circuit. Immersed in the roar of engines and the precision of racing machines, he knew he wanted to be involved. He pursued a degree in Aerospace Engineering, focusing on aerodynamics. After graduating, he joined Mitsubishi Motorsport, eager to apply his knowledge in a real-world racing environment.

As a wind tunnel operator, Jean-Luc meticulously analyzes airflow data and strives to optimize vehicle performance. He meticulously checks every piece of data, ensuring accuracy and reliability. His colleagues appreciate his innovative approach and his willingness to explore unconventional solutions. Jean-Luc is quickly earning a reputation for his technical expertise and his unwavering dedication to improving the team's performance.

Jean-Luc is a perfectionist, always seeking to refine his models and calculations. He believes that even the smallest adjustment can make a significant difference on the track. His visionary mindset allows him to see beyond the immediate challenges and envision the future possibilities of aerodynamic development.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: A young man of average height, Jean-Luc has a focused gaze and a determined expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee.
